analysis.title: GS Dunn - GS US Daily Download 7 Oct 2026
key_insights: The S&P 500 hit another all-time high at $7,844 on 10/6, the 28th record close of 2026.
The US trade deficit widened by $12.7bn to $105.6bn in August, above expectations. GS lowered its Q3 GDP tracking estimate by 0.3pp to +3.1% quarter-over-quarter annualized.
GS expects Marvell to hold its 6% gain after Investor Day. FY31 targets are above the Street: revenue CAGR of 55%-60% (FY26-31), gross margin 56%-59%, operating margin 44%-46%, EPS of about $30.

GS stays Neutral on Marvell at about 9.5x the FY31 EPS target, citing limited visibility into the timing and size of new design wins. It would turn more constructive with stronger execution evidence and a clearer ramp of other key design wins.
GS reiterates Buy on Costco with a 12-month price target of $1,134, expecting continued share gains in FY27.

Costco takeaways from the Texas club tour: more holiday SKUs y/y, strong DFW population growth as a share opportunity, new pay stations, Kirkland Signature performing well, tariff refunds being invested in price, and a push for more Executive members holding the Citi co-branded card.
GS published a Q3'26 eCommerce earnings preview centered on three questions: the state of the digital consumer, how agentic commerce reshapes competition, and holiday season expectations.

NDX and SPX drifted higher as the macro backdrop stabilized, with crude and rates calmer after a bid to Euro bonds overnight and Bessent commentary. Momentum traded lower for a second straight session and RTY was a large laggard.
GS's Power Up America basket (GSENEPOW) rose about 450bps and led the board after GOOGL headlines renewed focus on AI power demand. CEG rose 12%.
Hard disk drive stocks STX and WDC, both crowded longs, fell 8-10% on new competition concerns involving Toshiba. The move spread to semicap equipment (AMAT, KLAC, LRCX).
Biotech fell about 350bps. AVBP dropped 46% on a clinical miss and was only a small drag on XBI.
GS floor activity was a 4 on a 1-10 scale, finishing +670bps better to buy. Asset manager and hedge fund flows skewed to buy, driven by macro and tech pockets, but stayed muted.

Bartlett attributes the NDX breakout to clean positioning (GS PB hedge fund net exposure near a 5-year low, GS Sentiment indicator near multi-year lows), covering of macro products and hedges, and steady concentration of dollars into Tech/AI. Market breadth is at its lowest since 2000, and AI fundamental datapoints remain extremely strong.
